twitchImport.pageIntro: Bring your channel's details and emotes over from Twitch instead of retyping them. You connect your Twitch account once to prove it is yours; we read only public channel data and then give the access back.
twitchImport.loadFailed: The import could not be loaded.
twitchImport.unavailable.title: Import from Twitch is not available here
twitchImport.unavailable.body: This instance has not turned on importing from Twitch. You can still set up your channel by hand in the studio.
twitchImport.outcome.connected: Twitch is connected. Check the preview below and choose what to bring over.
twitchImport.outcome.denied: The connection was cancelled on Twitch. Nothing was read.
twitchImport.outcome.invalid: That connection link was not valid or has expired. Start again from this page.
twitchImport.outcome.mismatch: The Twitch account you connected does not match the account linked to your sign-in. Connect the same account.
twitchImport.outcome.failed: Twitch could not be read just now. Try again in a little while.
twitchImport.connect.title: Connect Twitch
twitchImport.connect.intro: No permissions are requested: connecting only proves the Twitch account is yours. The access is given back right after the read, and nothing is kept for later.
twitchImport.connect.failed: The connection could not be started.
twitchImport.preview.expired: This preview has expired. Connect Twitch again to read your channel fresh.
twitchImport.preview.categoryHint: The category is matched by name; with no match, your category stays as it is.
twitchImport.preview.mature: Twitch labels this channel's content as mature, so the import sets your mature label. An import never removes a mature label.
twitchImport.field.title: Title
twitchImport.fields.label: Channel details to import
twitchImport.fields.hint: Untick a detail to keep what your channel has now.
twitchImport.fields.matureKept: An import never removes a mature label.
twitchImport.emotes.heading: Emotes
twitchImport.emotes.none: This Twitch channel has no emotes to bring over.
twitchImport.schedule.heading: Schedule
twitchImport.schedule.carried: Carried, not applied: there is no schedule feature here yet, so these entries are kept with the import but nothing is scheduled.
twitchImport.assertion: I made this emote art or have the right to use it here. Imported emotes are checked like any upload and can be reported and removed.
twitchImport.assertionNeeded: Confirm you have the right to use the emote art first.
twitchImport.startConflict: This import cannot start: it expired or was already started.
twitchImport.startFailed: The import could not be started.
twitchImport.result.label: What was imported
twitchImport.reason.codeTaken: Your channel already has an emote with this code
twitchImport.reason.emoteLimit: Your channel has the most emotes it can have
twitchImport.reason.unsupportedType: The image type is not supported
twitchImport.reason.imageUnavailable: The image could not be fetched from Twitch
twitchImport.reason.invalidCode: The code cannot be used here (2 to 20 letters and digits)
twitchImport.reason.duplicateCode: Another emote has the same code
twitchImport.reason.unsupportedEmoteType: This kind of emote is not imported
twitchImport.reason.unavailableForAccoun: Importing is not available for this account right now
twitchImport.reason.turnedOff: Importing from Twitch was turned off
twitchImport.panels.title: Paste your panels
twitchImport.panels.intro: Twitch does not share panels with other services, so copy each panel's text from your Twitch channel page and paste it here. Start each panel with a heading line such as "# About me".
twitchImport.panels.label: Panel text
twitchImport.panels.hint: Formatting from the page is removed. Links starting with http or https are kept; a line holding only a link becomes the panel's link. Add images to panels afterwards.
